bootstrap.scope: Existing single generation and Judge score; does not include repeated-generation or repeated-Judge variance.

cases.category: 物体替换结构与编辑执行的权衡
cases.visual: SITEdit 右侧狗的身体很低、头颈和身体接合显得别扭；中间鹅的粉色和目标喙的红色等变化更贴近请求。
cases.comparison: Qwen2.1 的狗更像自然站立的狗，但粉色、红喙、删除等请求存在漏项或错位；MIRAGE 的狗形体也比 SITEdit 易辨认，仍有其他目标和尺度问题。
cases.judge: SITEdit PF 7.44 高于 Qwen2.1 的 2.96，但 PQ 3.20 低于 8.40；这是“做对更多项”和“生成结构好”不能合并为一个判断的例子。PQ 理由的头颈/动物结构问题与图中现象一致。
cases.instruction: Add a miniature scarf to the neck of the leftmost goose, and Change the color of the goose in the rear center near the planks to pink, and Change the color of the beak of the center goose with its head lowered to red, and Remove the foreground goose in the middle-right, and Replace the rightmost goose with a dog

cases.category: 同一目标的漏项和部件位置不对
cases.visual: SITEdit 雪和绿色可见，但最右羊身上的熔岩没做，黄色出现在头顶一带而非清晰覆盖两耳。删除左羊后的围栏修复也应查看细节。
cases.comparison: Qwen2.1、Qwen2511、MIRAGE 都能看到熔岩和黄色耳部；它们也有很强的合成质感或局部形体变化。RePlan 同样漏做熔岩。
cases.judge: SITEdit 的 PQ 较高不代表请求完成更好。Judge 对删除的理由把背景修补解释为“羊未删”，仅凭这一措辞不宜接受；本例最扎实的失败证据是熔岩漏做和耳部不对。
cases.instruction: Remove the leftmost sheep, and Add some snow onto the body of the second sheep from the left, and Change the color of the second sheep from the right to green, and Add some lava onto the body of the rightmost sheep, and Change the color of the ears of the rightmost sheep to yellow.

cases.category: 已有证据支持 Pass1 目标选择错误
cases.visual: SITEdit 击球手裤子仍是白色，最右背景坐着的人的腿部变蓝。捕手手中的替换物更像薄板；左后方背景人物衣服也有额外变化。
cases.comparison: Qwen2.1 和 Qwen2511 都把击球手裤子改蓝、完成更多前景请求，但小书本与手部细节仍非完美。RePlan 也改蓝裤子却漏掉其他请求；MIRAGE 发生明显模糊。
cases.judge: “击球手裤子未改蓝”的 PF 判断有图像依据。额外缓存检查进一步解释这个具体错目标：U1 解码区域落在最右背景腿部，最终也在那里变蓝；保存 token 与实际 S2 对应 U 行一致。
cases.instruction: Change the color of the pants of the rightmost person wearing a white T-shirt to blue, and Change the material of the baseball bat in the hands of the rightmost person wearing a white T-shirt to wood, and Change the color of the upper garment of the leftmost person to white, and Change the color of the helmet of the middle person to white, and Replace the glove in the hands of the middle person with a book.

cases.category: 定位合理后仍有跨目标传播
cases.visual: SITEdit 给后方男子加了完整黄安全帽，红衣女性头上只有局部黄色物；木质面板仍留有银色中心。
cases.comparison: Qwen2.1、Qwen2511、MIRAGE 更接近把帽子限定到红衣女性。RePlan 把帽子放在面板上。Qwen2.1 的陶瓷白衣质感及手与面板的接合也不完美。
cases.judge: 额外帽子和局部完成与 Cons/PF 理由一致。缓存 U2 解码区域覆盖红衣女性，且保存 token 接到正确 U2 行，说明不能简单归因于先定位了后方男子；具体注意力或训练机制仍未证实。
cases.instruction: Change the man at the far left to wear a bright red shirt, and Add a yellow safety helmet to the seated woman second from the left wearing a red shirt, and Change the man second from the right to wear a glossy ceramic white shirt, and Change the woman at the far right to have jet-black hair, and Change the large silver detector panel spanning the center foreground to wood.

cases.category: 定位合理后的承载对象错误；中等差距
cases.visual: 多数请求已呈现，最清楚的错误是白花贴在女性上衣，电脑没有花；这适合观察一个具体关联错误，不需要用极端崩坏图说明。
cases.comparison: Qwen2.1 的花在电脑屏幕，Qwen2511、RePlan、MIRAGE 也都落在电脑一带，但它们各有星星/椅子对象或形状改变。Qwen2.1 与 SITEdit 的大理石椅子形状都变了。
cases.judge: 该项 PF 扣分有明确图像依据。缓存 U5 解码区域覆盖电脑，保存 token 与实际 U5 行一致，却把花生成到上衣；支持区域条件接入后仍未正确用于该项编辑的诊断，不足以断言具体 attention 原因。
cases.instruction: Change the material of the leftmost wicker chair occupied by the woman looking to the left to marble, and Change the color of the cushion on the empty wicker chair with a white cushion against the fence to blue, and Add a yellow star pattern to the wicker chair at the back right partly hidden behind the woman wearing glasses, and Add a red cushion against the backrest of the green padded chair occupied by the woman using the laptop, and Add a white flower sticker onto the laptop resting on the lap of the woman.
